X000010034.title: Gamma SL Pant
X000010034.tagline: Lightweight, highly versatile softshell pant made from recycled materials. The Gamma SL Pant was previously the Gamma Lightweight Pant.

sections.heading: Gamma SL Pant
sections.body: Refined design, focused performance, made to move – our lightest Gamma is an all-mountain pant for summer adventure. The Fortius™ 1.0 softshell is made with 43% recycled content and delivers durable performance with the freedom of stretch. An adjustable low-profile waistbelt rides comfortably under a hipbelt or harness, and zippered hand pockets and a thigh pocket secure your smartphone and small essentials. Articulation is built in for added mobility, and eyelets at the hem accommodate shock cord to hold the cuffs over your boots.

features.title: Fit: Fitted
features.body: Our trimmer fit is patterned to stay close to the body through the chest, waist, hip, and thigh. Its low profile eliminates bulk, moves with the body, and fits comfortably under outer layers.

features.title: Technical features
features.body: Breathable · Lightweight · Durable · Wind resistant · Versatile · Water repellent

features.title: Construction
features.body: Fortius™ 1.0 softshell enables stretch and air flow automatically releasing excess heat

features.title: Cuff & Sleeves configuration
features.body: Eyelets at hem for shock cord attachments

features.title: Design & Fit
features.body: Tapered legs for maximum mobility · Garment Inseam: Size 4-S (Short) is 28"/72cm, Size 4-R (Regular) is 30"/77cm, Size 4-T (Tall) is 33"/84cm — Inseam varies by size

features.title: Fabric treatment
features.body: FC0-DWR (Durable Water Repellent) finish repels moisture

features.title: Patterning
features.body: Articulated patterning for unrestricted mobility

features.title: Pocket configuration
features.body: Two hand pockets with zippers · Thigh pocket with zip

features.title: Sustainability
features.body: Contains materials produced through processes that meet bluesign® criteria · Body - bluepass Material, recycled content · Lining - bluepass Material · PFAS (Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances) Compliant

features.title: UPF rating
features.body: UPF 50+, EN 13758-2,  AS4399:2020, GB/T 18830-2009. Only covered areas are protected. Protection may be reduced with use or if stretched or wet.

features.title: Waist & Belt configuration
features.body: Adjustable waistbelt fits comfortably under harnesses and backpacks

features.title: Materials
features.body: Lining: Warp knit mesh - 100% Polyester · Body: Fortius™  DW 1.0 - Woven Double Weave, 125gsm - 86% Nylon, 14% Elastane · Origin of fabric: TAIWAN, CHINA · Origin of dyeing: TAIWAN, CHINA · Origin of Manufacture:  BANGLADESH · May release plastic microfibres into the environment when washing

features.title: Care
features.body: Machine wash low · Tumble dry normal low · Do not bleach · Wash dark colours separately · Do not dry clean · Iron low · Do not use fabric softener · Double rinse

sections.body: The Spere SL Jacket is a superlight design featuring a front zippered closure, shirt collar, structured chest pocket, and internal pocket. Crafted with Ondritex, a breathable, quick-dry textile that offers next-to-skin comfort and a natural hand feel.

sections.heading: Veilance
sections.body: A system of essential forms designed for navigating urban environments.

features.title: Material
features.body: Crafted in Onditrex™, a featherlight 70% nylon–30% abaca blend, offers next-to-skin comfort with a natural paper-like hand feel. At 99 gsm, it delivers UPF 50+ protection, moisture-wicking, and a dry feel for comfort in warm conditions.

X000009527.title: Serratus Pant Men's
X000009527.tagline: Hybrid softshell climbing pant. Breathable in key zones. Tough everywhere else.

sections.heading: Our most technical climb softshell pant
sections.body: Looking to shave weight without sacrificing durability and mobility, we used two kinds of fabric to make these our most technical softshell pant. A durable softshell fabric made with 88% recycled content reinforces areas where climbers rub, drag and brush up against rock the most. Everywhere else, a highly breathable, lightweight fabric helps keep them as light as possible.

features.title: FC0 durable water repellent

features.title: Articulated construction
features.body: Articulation removes restriction, so we utilize complex patterning and seam placement to create three-dimensional designs that free you to move.
